title: Fleet Recall / Kubernetes
description: k0s node and workload health from kube-state-metrics, kubelet/cAdvisor, and node exporter. Separates metric coverage, Kubernetes state, container resource budgets, and scheduled-work results.

panels.title: k0s · workloads and the machine underneath them

options.content:
**Start with scrape health, then Kubernetes state, then resource pressure.** This view uses kube-state-metrics, kubelet/cAdvisor, and node exporter. Missing telemetry is **Unknown**, never a healthy zero.

Namespace and node filters scope pod/container views; deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, and CronJob controllers are namespace-wide. The default namespaces cover Fleet Recall and its local dependencies. Container logs are one click away in the dashboard links.

panels.title: Metrics targets reachable
panels.description: Share of discovered metrics targets up across nine infrastructure and monitoring jobs. A missing discovery job is not counted; inspect the job table below.

panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: Ready=true fraction of selected nodes according to Kubernetes. No Ready series is Unknown.

panels.title: Pending pods
panels.description: Current Pending pod count. Unscheduled pods are included with All nodes; a specific node selection excludes unassigned pods.

targets.expr: sum((max by (deployment,namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",phase="Pending"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: CrashLoop containers
panels.description: Current CrashLoopBackOff count. Zero fallback requires known container waiting-state metrics, not a constant.

targets.expr: sum((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"})) or sum(0 * ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Container restarts · 1h
panels.description: Estimated restart increase during the fixed last hour; real counters, reset-aware. Pod replacement creates new identities.

targets.expr: sum((sum by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace"}[1h]))) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Worst root disk used
panels.description: Worst available-capacity consumption on root filesystems of selected nodes. Uses available bytes rather than free bytes.

panels.title: Scrape endpoints
panels.description: Actual target health. Check for all nine jobs: kubernetes-nodes, kubernetes-cadvisor, kube-state-metrics, node-exporter, kubernetes-apiserver, prometheus, loki, alloy, grafana. A job with no discovered targets has no row.

panels.title: Node readiness
panels.description: Ready condition from kube-state-metrics. This is distinct from exporter reachability.

panels.title: Node pressure conditions
panels.description: Kubernetes pressure and network conditions. A value of zero is an explicitly observed clear condition.

panels.title: Node CPU busy
panels.description: Busy fraction averaged across all logical CPUs on each node; 100% means all cores busy.

panels.title: Node memory used
panels.description: Uses MemAvailable, which accounts for reclaimable memory; this is host pressure, not the sum of container working sets.

panels.title: Root filesystem used
panels.description: Available-capacity consumption for root mounts. Node exporter must observe the host root filesystem.

panels.title: Filesystem capacity used
panels.description: Persistent filesystem capacity, excluding virtual filesystems and per-pod mounts. Bind mounts may describe the same device; never sum capacities across these rows.

panels.title: Node allocatable resources
panels.description: Kubernetes allocatable CPU cores, memory bytes, and pod slots. Each row retains resource/unit; these distinct units are not added. Capacity is discovered, not hardcoded to the local VM.

panels.title: Deployment unavailable replicas
panels.description: Namespace-wide deployment controller state. The environment deployment label is separate from workload_deployment, normalized by the scrape configuration.

panels.title: StatefulSet ready / desired
panels.description: Ready replica fraction for StatefulSets with positive desired replicas. Scaled-to-zero or missing desired counts do not become a healthy 100%.

panels.title: DaemonSet ready / desired
panels.description: Namespace-wide DaemonSet coverage; ready divided by desired scheduled pods, only for positive desired count.

panels.title: Active pod readiness
panels.description: Running, Pending, or Unknown phase pods. Completed Jobs are excluded so completion is not mistaken for an unready service.

targets.expr: ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod) (kube_pod_status_ready{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",condition="true"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",phase=~"Running|Pending|Unknown"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Waiting containers
panels.description: Current active waiting reasons; ContainerCreating may be normal during startup. Empty results mean none reported or missing telemetry: check exporter coverage.

panels.title: CPU cores · usage / requests / limits
panels.description: Same unit: CPU cores. Runtime usage is CPU seconds per second; requests/limits sum regular-container specifications on selected nodes. These exclude init/overhead and pod-level resource budgets. Limits may be absent; absence is not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment,namespace) ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="cpu",unit="core"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

sum by (deployment,namespace) ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="cpu",unit="core"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Memory · working set / requests / limits
panels.description: Same unit: bytes. Working set is observed container memory; request/limit lines are regular-container configuration totals. Missing limits remain missing; a partial total is not a complete namespace cap.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment,namespace) ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

sum by (deployment,namespace) ((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Hottest containers · CPU cores
panels.description: Top ten observed regular containers by CPU cores. cAdvisor sandbox and empty-container parent cgroups are excluded.

panels.title: Container memory / explicit limit
panels.description: Working set as a fraction of a positive explicit regular-container memory limit. Unbounded or unreported limits produce no ratio; they are not assigned zero usage.

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node",container!="",container!="POD"}) / on (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (((max by (deployment,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",resource="memory",unit="byte"})) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node"})) > 0))

panels.title: Container CPU throttling · periods
panels.description: Percent of CFS scheduling periods throttled, not percent CPU time lost. Positive denominator only; missing/unsupported cgroup metrics stay absent. Top ten are selected independently at each evaluation.

panels.title: Pod network · received / transmitted
panels.description: Bytes/second by pod. Max per pod/interface removes duplicate sandbox series before summing interfaces; application containers and loopback are excluded. Only host_network=false pods are included, since host-network counters cannot be uniquely attributed to pods.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment,namespace,pod) (max by (deployment,namespace,pod,interface) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node",pod!="",container=~"POD|^$",interface!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node",host_network="false"})

sum by (deployment,namespace,pod) (max by (deployment,namespace,pod,interface) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node",pod!="",container=~"POD|^$",interface!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (deployment,namespace,pod) max by (deployment,namespace,pod) (kube_pod_info{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace",node=~"$node",host_network="false"})

panels.title: Container restarts · last hour
panels.description: Reset-aware counter increase over one hour. This is a bounded recent estimate, not a count over the dashboard range.

panels.title: Last termination was OOMKilled
panels.description: Latest retained container termination reason, not an OOM event rate and not necessarily an event in the selected range. This KSM metric may be unavailable; no data stays unknown.

panels.title: CronJob age since successful completion
panels.description: Age of the last successful completion recorded by Kubernetes; not the last schedule time. Each CronJob has its own schedule, so compare age with that schedule.

panels.title: CronJobs with no success recorded
panels.description: Known CronJobs without a positive last-successful timestamp. New or suspended CronJobs can appear here; inspect the schedule and suspend state before treating this as an incident.

panels.title: Failed Jobs still retained
panels.description: Terminal Failed condition of Job objects still retained by Kubernetes. This is not failed-pod count and not a historical total; Job TTL/history cleanup removes objects.

panels.title: CronJob active executions
panels.description: Current active Job references per CronJob. Correlate with concurrency policy and schedule; no CronJobs yields no data.

panels.title: Unsuspended CronJobs · schedule lateness
panels.description: Seconds past the KSM next-schedule timestamp for unsuspended CronJobs. Zero means the next scheduled time is still in the future; this says nothing about the success of previous executions.

targets.expr: clamp_min(time() - max by (deployment,namespace,cronjob) (kube_cronjob_next_schedule_time{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace"}), 0) and on (deployment,namespace,cronjob) (max by (deployment,namespace,cronjob) (kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{job="kube-state-metrics",deployment=~"$deployment",cluster="k0s",namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 0)

options.content:
**No data is a coverage question first.** Check all nine infrastructure and monitoring scrape jobs, then whether the selected namespaces/nodes contain that resource. Sparse waiting/OOM/Job series and zero-replica controllers require context; they are not automatically green.

**Memory and throttling:** correlate positive explicit limits with working set, restart increases, and last termination reasons. CFS throttling is a fraction of scheduling periods. Container requests/limits are configuration totals, not full scheduler accounting for init containers, pod overhead, or pod-level resources.

**Storage and network:** inspect persistent mounts without summing bind mounts. Pod network de-duplicates sandbox series and excludes host networking.

**CronJobs and Fleet workers:** Kubernetes completion status and the application worker snapshot are separate signals. Open **Workers** for the application result and **Logs** for container output; maintain Kubernetes log access controls and retention in the collector.
